about_the_game: The deadly effects of Corona and how hundreds of thousands of people died are still in our minds. We decided to turn this dangerous disease into a beautiful game. For this, we developed an ARCADE style game. In the game, the player fights with coronaviruses. The player must protect himself and win the fight. Otherwise, he will die. In order for the player to win the fight, he must take his medicine on time. Each pill taken will make the player energetic for 8 seconds and during this time the viruses will not be able to attack the player. In the meantime, the player will collect points by taking vitamins C and D, killing viruses and chewing pawns. Every 10,000 points collected will give the player a new life. If no medicine is taken after 8 seconds after the medicine is taken, the viruses will become stronger and attack the player. When the number of lives, which is 5 at the beginning, becomes 0, the player loses his life. However, if the player can resist and complete level 6, the player has won, All Corona viruses have been killed and destroyed as they are, the player has definitely managed to survive.
